From: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@aegissystems.com>

Cc: contracts@aegissystems.com
Date: 2025-03-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Updated redlines + questions on Section 7 & 12

Marissa — attaching an updated redline bundle (Aegis_MSA_redlines_v2.docx). Our counsel has two open clarifications they want addressed in your counter:

1) Section 7 (Data Processing): They want explicit language confirming that Redwood will not transfer Aegis production data outside the US without prior written consent.
2) Section 12 (Indemnity & Liability): They proposed removing Redwood's liability cap for third-party data breach claims.

Can Laura advise if (1) a U.S.-only residency commitment is feasible as a contractual option and (2) whether Redwood will consider an exceptions process for uncapped liability tied to gross negligence / willful misconduct?

Also, per your earlier note, please send any compliance artifacts (SOC2 summary, encryption references) that will help speed internal approval. We remain hopeful for a counter by tomorrow so we can keep our procurement window.

Attachments: Aegis_MSA_redlines_v2.docx

Regards,
Sarah Nolan
Sr. Contracts Manager
Aegis Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@aegissystems.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-13T17:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated redlines + questions on Section 7 & 12

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the clarity. Laura will run the two asks through Legal and should be able to advise on residency language options (we do offer region-locked deployments for Dedicated/Private customers, and can propose a U.S.-only residency clause as an Order Form-dependent commitment). On liability: our standard position is to have a mutual cap tied to fees; uncapped liability is limited to willful misconduct/gross negligence. Laura, can you confirm if we can propose an exceptions process for specific breach scenarios?

I'll attach the SOC2 summary and our encryption / key-management FAQ in a follow-up note to help your internal review. In the meantime, let's book a 30-minute intake call Thursday 10:00 AM PT — will that work for Aegis?

Marissa Cole
